parts.name: body
sources: A 12 oz long neck beer bottle: 9.09 in (23.1 cm) high, 2.4 in (6.1 cm) across, 355 ml (https://www.dimensions.com/element/beer-bottle-12-oz-long-neck).
The crown cap of a longneck: 26 mm. The shoulder and the neck: by eye from photos of the bottle; the wall of 2 mm gives about 220 g of glass (a longneck: about 200 g).
